baron1: Travelers, I summoned you because my herald, Ser Aldric of Velhast, lies dead with no apparent wound.
Baron2: If the truth is not presented before dawn, the truce will break and the border will burn.
Baron3: I need neutral eyes. You answer neither to my enemies nor to my vassals.
Menu_Stakes: What’s at stake if we fail?
Menu_Hold: Not yet. We need a moment.
Baron4_WhyUs: My captains see enemies in every shadow; my clerics see guilt in every breath.
Baron5_WhyUs: You stand outside the dispute: paladin, witch, barber-surgeon, archer… neutral to my houses and the neighboring realm.
Baron6_WhyUs: I need a truth that cannot be dismissed as a political tool.
Baron7_Stakes: If you do not resolve this before sunrise, the border lords will demand blood.
Baron8_Stakes: The peace signing will fall; caravans and villages will pay for a death without reason.
Baron9_Stakes: And if you accuse without proof, the clock will hasten toward dawn. I won’t make that mistake again.
Baron10_Reward: If you bring a solid, presentable truth:
Baron11_Reward: — Gold: {RewardGold} crowns; — Prestige: rank {RewardReputation} at my court; — A signed safe-conduct to travel my lands.
Baron12_Reward: If you avert war, I’ll add supplies for your company and a quarter-load of provisions at the posts.
Liora1_Accept: We accept. We will serve the truth.
Baron13_Accept: Good. The night begins now: Deep Night.
Baron14_Accept: You may move through the castle. Bring evidence, not rumors.
Torval1_Hold: A moment, my lord. We must order our questions.
Baron15_Hold: Do not delay; the night won’t wait.
